snippet.title: My life with you - Sorora Game Studio
snippet.description:
"My Life with You" tells the story of a young woman who, after falling in love as a teenager, ends up getting pregnant. Abandoned by her boyfriend, she must face the challenges of being a single mother, balancing work, household responsibilities, and her dream of building a better future for herself and her child. Living with her grandmother, she seeks a job to support their home while dealing with the struggles of motherhood and the possibility of finding love again. At the core of it all is the bond between mother and child, showing the highs and lows of a journey filled with challenges, growth, and love.

This project was carried out with resources from Complementary Law No. 195/2022 – Paulo Gustavo Law, funded by the Paulo Gustavo Law, IECINE/RS, the State Department of Culture of Rio Grande do Sul, the Ministry of Culture, and the Federal Government, with execution by Sorora Game Studio.
